label: Loft
params: sections: [{sketch, profiles?} | {sketch, point: id} (an apex)] (2…50, in order; matching hole counts, no holes at an apex); rails?: [{sketch, curves: [ids in order]}] (one or two guide rails from the first section to the last, through every section's outline: the loft follows them between the sections; not with sections that have holes); rail_fit?: scale|stretch (default scale: with one rail the sections grow evenly with the rail's distance from their middle, with two with the distance between the rails; stretch: only that way); operation?, touching?, targets? (Join excludes hidden bodies from automatic targets; explicit targets or participants may include them), name?, body_name?
